caption: The video captures a stemmed wine glass of clear, bubbly liquid on a wooden table, with a hand holding a printed sheet behind it. The sheet shows a blue letterform left, a red letterform right, and a yellow band at the edge, against a chair back and wire. The waterline bisects the letters, leaving tops unrefracted and bottoms bent through the liquid. The hand slides the sheet slowly side to side, so the refracted blue form alternates between a broad angled block with a white gap and thin bar. The red form also shifts, losing its bright interior and becoming mostly solid within the bowl. The unrefracted tops shift only slightly, while the submerged forms change more noticeably. The glass, table, chair, and wire stay fixed, and bubbles cling to the wall, so the reshaping follows the sheet.
